invariants.title: The look goes up
invariants.rule: Her eyes and head go UP the stack, not toward him.
invariants.why: This is the shot where she decides; the audience has to see where the idea comes from.

invariants.title: Her face holds
invariants.rule: Her face at the end of the take is still hers.
invariants.why: A close-up is where a drifted face shows most.

invariants.title: The camera is still
invariants.why: The decision is small; the frame stays out of its way.

flair.title: Jaw
flair.note: sets at the end, not before

title: the stack
beat: Nadia opens her eyes and looks straight up the stack of crates she is leaning on. Her jaw sets. The plan arrives.
